title: Contact detail may be visible publicly
evidence: Contact address shown in the post: user@example.test
description: A public post appears to contain an email address. It may be intentional; check the original source and whether the address is meant to be public.
suggested_action: Check the original post and remove or replace the address if it is personal.

title: Repeated routine may reveal a pattern
evidence: Posts mention the same venue and approximate time on multiple days.
description: Several public posts appear to mention a repeated time and place. Review whether sharing this pattern is necessary.
suggested_action: Consider removing precise routine details from public posts.

title: Phone-like number appears in a caption
description: A caption includes a phone-like sequence. It may be a public business contact or placeholder; verify before acting.
suggested_action: Confirm whether the number is intended to be public.

title: Similar display name found on another profile
evidence: Display names appear similar; profile ownership has not been verified.
description: A second profile uses a similar display name. Similar names alone do not establish impersonation.
suggested_action: Compare profile URLs and other context before reporting.

title: Precise location detail may be exposed
evidence: Caption includes a specific venue and near-future arrival/departure detail.
description: A public caption includes a specific place and near-future timing. Review whether this information should remain public.
suggested_action: Remove real-time location details if they could create a safety risk.
